scripts.purpose: Runs on a server, discovers Git repositories under SEARCH_DIR, and reports working-tree changes and ahead/behind status against each branch's upstream, followed by a summary. Settings come from USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG, the installed config, or the repository's remote/config template; arguments are ignored. install.sh deploys this script to each host in REMOTE_SERVERS, and it is invoked by remote/arch-server-maintenance.sh through GIT_CHECKER.

environment.name: USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG
environment.description: Explicit config path; takes precedence over the installed config and remote/config. An unreadable explicit path is an error.

environment.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environment.description: Base directory for the installed config lookup.

environment.name: HOME
environment.description: Base for config-defined paths and the default search root.

environment.name: SEARCH_DIR
environment.description: Root directory searched for Git repositories.

write_paths: Git refs/FETCH_HEAD under each discovered repository (git fetch --prune)
network_hosts: git remotes of repositories under SEARCH_DIR

exit_codes.meaning: The repository summary completed; dirty, diverged, detached, or upstream-less repositories are counted in the summary but do not fail the script.
